"use client";

import { Button, HStack } from "@chakra-ui/react"
import { DarkMode, LightMode, useColorMode } from "@/components/rendyn-libraries/chakra/upstream/ui/color-mode"

export const ColorModeForced = () => {
  const { toggleColorMode } = useColorMode()
  return (
    <HStack>
      <LightMode>
        <Button size="sm" variant="subtle">
          Light Mode Always
        </Button>
      </LightMode>

      <DarkMode>
        <Button size="sm" variant="subtle">
          Dark Mode Always
        </Button>
      </DarkMode>

      <Button size="sm" variant="subtle" onClick={toggleColorMode}>
        Toggle Mode
      </Button>
    </HStack>
  )
}

Choose or inspect a color value.

- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
